user.title: Suggested actions
user.description: Learns which quick actions you click at this time of day and day of the week, and ranks them in one sensor. It suggests; it never runs anything. Add your actions afterwards, from the integration card.

data_description.name: Gives the sensor its id: `Suggested actions` makes `sensor.suggested_actions_ranking`.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only one instance is needed.

data_description.top_size: How many actions the `top` attribute lists at most.
data_description.threshold: Roughly how many times an action must have been used at the same moment before it is suggested. 1 is quick to react, 3 is cautious.
data_description.half_life_days: After this many days, a use counts half as much. A habit you drop fades on its own.
data_description.debounce_minutes: Several clicks on the same action within this window count once — nudging the temperature three times is one intention.
data_description.users: Empty learns from every person. Automations, physical buttons and voice satellites never count: they have no user.

user.title: Action
user.description: A click on any of these entities, from a dashboard or the app, counts as one use of this action.

data_description.name: Also gives the action its id in the `top` attribute — `Robot vacuum` becomes `robot_vacuum`. The id is fixed once created, so renaming does not break your dashboard templates.
data_description.entities: Several when one action has several faces, such as an air conditioning script and the climate entity itself. A script that switches on another tracked entity counts once, for the script.
